verdict: Organic search is growing; overdue CRM and outreach blockers need resolution now.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, every measurable demand signal is organic — 394 combined Google Business Profile actions and 596 search clicks, with no paid spend active on Meta or Google Ads. Search visibility is trending in the right direction, with clicks up meaningfully week over week at O'Hare (+31%), Advance Grinding (+14%), and Forte (+20%), reflecting genuine local search momentum. However, several CRM and outreach milestones that were due as far back as July remain unresolved, and until the stub account reconciliation is completed, the CRM pipeline cannot be fully trusted. Website tracking is also returning zero sessions across all entities despite real search activity, so that figure under-reports actual traffic and is being corrected. The focus this coming period is clearing those blockers so outreach sequences and CRM automation can activate as planned.

watch_item.fix: Reconciliation and the contact pull are being prioritized this period to unblock the outreach sequences and restore full CRM visibility before the end of September.
